questions.question: Which module declares `ADCharacter`, and what is its immediate parent class?
What does `ADCharacter::ApplyDamage` do, and what are its `UFUNCTION` specifiers?
questions.key: Applies damage to this character. Server only. Always call this rather than setting Health directly: Health is replicated with a condition, and writing to it outside this function skips the replication bookkeeping, so clients will keep the stale value until some unrelated property forces a resend.  Specifiers: BlueprintCallable, Native
